changes.evidence: The [Western Carolina University Chem 132 procedure, printed p3](https://www2.chem21labs.com/labfiles/westerncarolina_gl132lab03_procedure.pdf) specifies 0.1 M CaCl2, a nichrome wire loop, a thin solution film and brief placement at the top of the blue cone to observe colour. The [RSC procedure](https://edu.rsc.org/experiments/flame-tests-the-wooden-splint-method/759.article) identifies calcium as brick-red. Together these verify documented use of the requested concentration and loop method, not guaranteed visibility on every bench. Use a clean loop and the documented flame conditions; no concentration change is inferred.

[Cancer Australia melanoma statistics](https://www.canceraustralia.gov.au/cancer-types/melanoma-skin/melanoma-skin-statistics), updated 18 December 2025 and explicitly sourced to AIHW Cancer Data in Australia 2025, prints 17,443 estimated new cases in 2025: 10,187 males plus 7,256 females. It also gives 94% five-year relative survival for 2017 to 2021. The exact count and rounded 17,400 tag are supported when labelled as the 2025 estimate. Relative survival is not an individual cure chance.
